body:
Review pass 11. Status: work appears PAUSED, and the partial Epic 4 landing is verified good.

PAUSE SIGNAL. mote board reports 0 active claims, Epic 4 still in doing with a lapsed lease, Epic 0A released back to open, and no file writes for 10+ minutes (compiler.R last touched 08:00:56). If that is deliberate, ignore this; if the session dropped, the state below is where it stopped.

The tree is HEALTHY at the pause point: package loads, suite 1815 pass / 0 fail / 0 error / 0 warn / 2 skip (up from 1770). Nothing is half-broken.

EPIC 4 - both original defects are FIXED, verified independently:
- Receipt is no longer a literal. compiler.R:756-766 reads normalizer/transform/reducer from task$, lowering from task$lowering, order from plan$task$stages$order, metric_schedule and tiles from plan$. Previously hardcoded at :690-699.
- Execution flows through the plan: .run_geometry_compiler -> plan_geometry() -> .compile_geometry_execution_plan() -> .execute_geometry_plan(). No more compile-then-discard.
Behavioural checks: geometry(plan) == geometry(rel, at, over) numerically to 0 with identical plan ids; geometry(plan, at = at) refused with "A compiled geometry plan cannot be combined with raw plan inputs"; evaluate_geometry accepts the same plan and agrees. plan_geometry is exported and documented as the preferred route, which also delivers the query-first direction.

That closes the compiler half of my original review. Nice.

CHECKED AND DISMISSED, no bead: feature-block partitions differ by 1-2 ULP (2.2e-16 between block 6 and block 2, not bitwise identical). That is well inside your declared contract at test-kernel.R:243 - numerical_agreement(guarantee = "block_partition", atol = 1e-12, rtol = 1e-11). Not a regression, not a defect. Worth one remark only: bd-01KZXD7G0E5KEDMC2VCGVKGNS7 asks the METRIC path to be stricter than this, and that is still right - this path is linear, whereas the metric path inverts and amplifies drift by the condition number.

ONE THING I WOULD DO BEFORE RESUMING: commit. bd-01KZXFZ4WRKASSWYMDSECG8FED is now more pressing precisely because work paused. 16 untracked R files and 26 untracked test files, including all of Epics 1-3 and this Epic 4 work, with no recovery point.
